senses.en: Not allowed by law

ex.en: It is illegal to park here overnight without permission.
ex.zh: 未经许可在这里通宵停车是违法的。

ex.en: Stronger international cooperation is needed to prevent illegal fishing and protect vulnerable marine ecosystems.
ex.zh: 需要加强国际合作，以防止非法捕捞并保护脆弱的海洋生态系统。

col: make something illegal｜将某事定为违法
tip: 常用句型：It is illegal to do sth.。
教材补充词；首次出现于高一下，来源：必修第二册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: To make something clear through examples or evidence.
To provide pictures for a book or other publication.

ex.en: She used two jars to illustrate the difference.
ex.zh: 她用两个罐子来说明其中的区别。

ex.en: These findings illustrate how access to public transport can improve employment opportunities in disadvantaged communities.
ex.zh: 这些研究结果说明，公共交通的可及性如何改善弱势社区的就业机会。

col: illustrate a point｜说明一个观点
illustrate the importance of｜说明……的重要性
tip: illustrate可用例子说明，不一定涉及图片。

senses.en: without waiting or any delay
directly before, after, or next to something
as soon as something happens

ex.en: When the doorbell rang, I immediately opened the door.
ex.zh: 门铃一响，我就立刻打开了门。

ex.en: Schools should respond immediately to safety concerns rather than waiting for a serious incident to occur.
ex.zh: 学校应立即回应安全方面的担忧，而不是等到严重事件发生才采取行动。

tip: 作连词表示“一……就”主要见于英式英语。
教材补充词；首次出现于高一下，来源：必修第三册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: a strong effect on someone or something
the force or action of one object hitting another
to affect someone or something, often strongly

ex.en: The new playground had a positive impact on our neighbourhood.
ex.zh: 新游乐场给我们社区带来了积极影响。

ex.en: Governments should assess the environmental impact of major construction projects before allowing work to begin.
ex.zh: 政府应在批准开工之前评估大型建设项目对环境的影响。

col: have an impact on｜对……有影响
tip: 名词重音在前；动词通常读/ɪmˈpækt/。

senses.zh: 进口；进口商品；进口；输入；引进；以防：以防万一；作为回报；作为回应

tip: 教材补充词；首次出现于高一下，来源：必修第三册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: Money received regularly from work, investments, or other sources.

ex.en: My weekend job gives me a small extra income.
ex.zh: 我的周末兼职给我带来一小笔额外收入。

ex.en: Affordable public transport allows families on low incomes to access employment and essential services more easily.
ex.zh: 价格实惠的公共交通让低收入家庭更容易获得就业机会和基本服务。

tip: income范围比salary广，也包括租金、投资收益。

senses.en: Used to confirm something or emphasize that it is true.
Used to add information that strengthens a previous statement.

ex.en: The soup was very tasty indeed, so I had more.
ex.zh: 这汤确实非常好喝，所以我又喝了一些。

ex.en: Public transport can reduce congestion; indeed, reliable bus services may persuade many commuters to stop driving.
ex.zh: 公共交通能够缓解拥堵；事实上，可靠的公交服务可能使许多通勤者放弃开车。

col: very useful indeed｜确实非常有用
tip: 可用very＋形容词＋indeed加强语气。

senses.en: able to live or act without relying on others
not controlled by another person, organisation, or country
not connected with or affected by something else

ex.en: Living alone has made me much more independent.
ex.zh: 独居让我变得更加独立。

ex.en: Independent research can help governments assess whether new environmental policies are achieving their intended goals.
ex.zh: 独立研究可以帮助政府评估新的环境政策是否正在实现预期目标。

tip: 常搭配of：independent of意为不依赖或不受影响。

senses.en: Without needing help or support from others.
Separately, without being connected to or influenced by something else.

ex.en: My grandmother still lives independently in her own flat.
ex.zh: 我祖母仍独立生活在自己的公寓里。

ex.en: Students who learn to work independently are often better prepared for the demands of higher education.
ex.zh: 学会独立完成任务的学生，往往能更好地应对高等教育的要求。

tip: 表示“不依赖于……”用independently of。

senses.en: to show that something exists or is likely
to direct attention to something, often by pointing

ex.en: These dark clouds indicate that rain is coming.
ex.zh: 这些乌云表明快要下雨了。

ex.en: Recent surveys indicate that affordable housing remains a major concern for young adults in urban areas.
ex.zh: 近期调查表明，经济适用住房仍是城市年轻人十分关心的问题。

tip: 表示“表明……”时，常接that从句。

senses.en: Relating to one person or thing rather than a group
One person or living thing considered separately from others
Having qualities that make someone or something different from others

ex.en: The teacher gave each child an individual box of crayons.
ex.zh: 老师给每个孩子单独发了一盒彩色蜡笔。

ex.en: Education systems should recognise individual learning needs rather than expect every student to progress at the same pace.
ex.zh: 教育体系应重视个人的学习需求，而不是指望每个学生都以相同的速度进步。

tip: 形容词强调单个或个人；作可数名词指一个人或个体。
教材补充词；首次出现于高一下，来源：必修第三册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: An arrangement providing financial protection against specified risks.
Something that protects against a possible future problem.

ex.en: Our travel insurance covered the cost of my lost suitcase.
ex.zh: 我们的旅行保险赔付了我丢失行李箱的费用。

ex.en: Affordable health insurance can prevent families from facing serious financial difficulties when someone becomes ill.
ex.zh: 价格可负担的医疗保险可以避免家庭在有人生病时陷入严重的经济困境。

tip: 通常不可数；保险费用premium，保单用policy。

senses.en: Able to learn, understand, and think well.
Able to process information and respond automatically in useful ways.

ex.en: Our intelligent puppy quickly learned how to open doors.
ex.zh: 我们那只聪明的小狗很快就学会了开门。

ex.en: Intelligent transport systems can reduce congestion by adjusting traffic signals in response to changing road conditions.
ex.zh: 智能交通系统可以根据道路状况的变化调整交通信号，从而缓解拥堵。

tip: intelligent指聪明的；intelligible指可理解的。

senses.en: To have a plan or purpose in mind.
To mean something or design it for a particular purpose.

ex.en: I intend to finish painting the kitchen this weekend.
ex.zh: 我打算这周末刷完厨房。

ex.en: The council intends to expand public transport services to reduce dependence on private cars.
ex.zh: 地方议会打算扩大公共交通服务，以减少人们对私家车的依赖。

col: intend to do something｜打算做某事
tip: intend to do表示打算做；be intended for表示供……用。

senses.en: Something that you plan or mean to do.

ex.en: I had no intention of staying out so late.
ex.zh: 我原本没打算在外面待到这么晚。

ex.en: The government announced its intention to expand public transport in order to reduce traffic congestion.
ex.zh: 政府宣布计划扩大公共交通服务，以缓解交通拥堵。

col: with the intention of｜抱着…的目的
announce an intention to｜宣布做…的打算
tip: 用intention to do或intention of doing。

senses.en: To examine facts carefully to discover what happened or why.
To study a subject carefully to learn more about it.

ex.en: A plumber came to investigate the strange noise upstairs.
ex.zh: 一位水管工来查明楼上怪声的原因。

ex.en: Researchers are investigating how access to green spaces affects the mental health of urban residents.
ex.zh: 研究人员正在探究接触绿地如何影响城市居民的心理健康。

tip: 直接接调查对象：investigate the problem，不加into。

senses.en: relating to Ireland, its people, or their culture
a Celtic language traditionally spoken in Ireland
the people of Ireland, referred to collectively

ex.en: An Irish musician played the fiddle at our festival.
ex.zh: 一位爱尔兰音乐家在我们的节庆活动上拉小提琴。

ex.en: Traditional Irish music can strengthen cultural identity while attracting visitors to rural communities across the country.
ex.zh: 爱尔兰传统音乐既能增强文化认同，也能吸引游客前往全国各地的乡村社区。

tip: the Irish统称爱尔兰人；单个人用an Irish person。

senses.en: An important subject or problem that needs discussion.
To officially announce or give something to people.
One edition of a regularly published newspaper or magazine.

ex.en: We discussed the parking issue at our neighbourhood meeting.
ex.zh: 我们在邻里会议上讨论了停车问题。

ex.en: Governments must address the issue of housing affordability to ensure that young adults can live independently.
ex.zh: 政府必须解决住房负担能力问题，确保年轻人能够独立生活。

col: a controversial issue｜有争议的议题
tip: issue 作问题常指需讨论的议题，不一定是困难。

senses.zh: 玉；翡翠：玉器；玉兔；月球车

tip: 教材补充词；首次出现于高一下，来源：必修第三册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

tip: 教材补充词；首次出现于高一下，来源：必修第二册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: a publication containing articles about a particular subject
a personal record of experiences, thoughts, or events

ex.en: I keep a journal beside my bed every night.
ex.zh: 我每晚都把一本日记放在床边。

ex.en: Researchers publish their findings in academic journals so that other experts can evaluate the evidence.
ex.zh: 研究人员在学术期刊上发表成果，以便其他专家评估相关证据。

tip: journal常指专业期刊；表示私人记录时近似diary。
教材补充词；首次出现于高一下，来源：必修第三册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: An Australian mammal with powerful hind legs; females carry pouch young.

ex.en: A young kangaroo peeked out of its mother's pouch.
ex.zh: 一只小袋鼠从妈妈的育儿袋里探出头来。

ex.en: Habitat loss can force kangaroo populations closer to roads, increasing the risk of collisions with vehicles.
ex.zh: 栖息地丧失可能迫使袋鼠种群靠近道路，增加它们与车辆相撞的风险。

col: a kangaroo's pouch｜袋鼠的育儿袋
tip: 复数直接加-s：kangaroos；育儿袋叫pouch。

senses.en: very interested in something or eager to do it
quick to notice or understand things
very strong or intense

ex.en: Leila is keen to join our weekend hiking group.
ex.zh: 莱拉很想加入我们的周末徒步小组。

ex.en: Students who are keen on science benefit from practical experiments that connect theory with everyday experience.
ex.zh: 热爱科学的学生能从将理论与日常经验相结合的实践实验中受益。

col: a keen eye for detail｜敏锐的细节观察力
tip: keen on后接名词或动名词；keen to后接动词原形。

senses.en: A school or class for children beginning their education

ex.en: My daughter painted a bright yellow bird at kindergarten.
ex.zh: 我女儿在幼儿园画了一只鲜黄色的小鸟。

ex.en: High-quality kindergarten education can develop children's social skills and prepare them for more structured learning.
ex.zh: 优质的学前教育能培养儿童的社交能力，为更系统的学习做好准备。

tip: 美式常指小学前的一年；英式幼儿园常用nursery。
教材补充词；首次出现于高一下，来源：必修第二册；选择性必修第四册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: a light inside a protective container, often with a handle

ex.en: He carried a lantern along the dark garden path.
ex.zh: 他提着一盏灯，沿着漆黑的花园小径走去。

ex.en: Solar lanterns provide affordable lighting in remote communities where reliable access to electricity remains limited.
ex.zh: 在仍难以稳定用电的偏远社区，太阳能灯提供了价格实惠的照明。

tip: 指有外罩的灯，常可提携；不等同于手电筒。
教材补充词；首次出现于高一下，来源：必修第三册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: To introduce a product or start an organised activity.
To send something into space or put a boat into water.
The act of introducing something or sending it into motion.

ex.en: Our local bakery launched a new delivery service yesterday.
ex.zh: 我们当地的面包店昨天推出了新的送货服务。

ex.en: Schools should launch awareness campaigns to encourage healthier eating habits and reduce food waste among students.
ex.zh: 学校应开展宣传活动，鼓励学生养成更健康的饮食习惯，并减少食物浪费。

tip: 推出产品、发起活动和发射卫星都可用launch。

senses.en: Bend or rest against something in a sloping position.
Having little body fat or containing little fat.
Using few resources while avoiding waste.

ex.en: She leaned against the wall and untied her shoes.
ex.zh: 她靠着墙，解开了鞋带。

ex.en: Lean production methods can help manufacturers reduce waste while maintaining the quality of their products.
ex.zh: 精益生产方法能帮助制造商在保持产品质量的同时减少浪费。

tip: lean against指倚靠；lean towards可指倾向于。
教材补充词；首次出现于高一下，来源：必修第三册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: Relating to laws or the system that applies them
Allowed by the law

ex.en: We sought legal advice before signing the rental agreement.
ex.zh: 签订租赁协议前，我们征求了法律意见。

ex.en: Access to affordable legal services is essential for ensuring that disadvantaged citizens can defend their rights.
ex.zh: 让人们获得负担得起的法律服务，对保障弱势公民维护自身权利至关重要。

tip: legal可指“法律相关的”，不一定指“合法的”。
教材补充词；首次出现于高一下，来源：必修第二册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: the greatest amount or level that is allowed or possible
to control how much something can increase or happen

ex.en: There is a limit to what this bag can hold.
ex.zh: 这个包能装的东西是有限的。

ex.en: Governments should limit industrial emissions while providing financial support for businesses adopting cleaner production methods.
ex.zh: 政府应限制工业排放，同时为采用更清洁生产方式的企业提供资金支持。

col: limit something to｜将某事物限制在
tip: limit A to B意为将A限制在B范围内。

senses.en: Small in amount or restricted in range

ex.en: We have limited space, so choose a smaller sofa.
ex.zh: 我们空间有限，所以选一张小一点的沙发吧。

ex.en: Students with limited access to reliable internet may struggle to participate fully in online learning.
ex.zh: 难以获得稳定网络连接的学生可能无法充分参与在线学习。

tip: be limited to表示“仅限于”，to后接名词或动名词。

senses.en: To walk unevenly because one leg or foot is hurt
An uneven way of walking caused by an affected leg
Not firm or stiff; lacking strength or support

ex.en: I had to limp home after twisting my ankle.
ex.zh: 扭伤脚踝后，我只好一瘸一拐地走回家。

ex.en: Athletes who continue to limp after an injury should receive professional assessment before returning to competitive sport.
ex.zh: 受伤后仍然跛行的运动员应先接受专业评估，再重返竞技运动。

col: walk with a limp｜一瘸一拐地走
tip: 作动词指跛行；作形容词指无力或软塌塌。

senses.en: Either fleshy edge of the opening of the mouth.
The projecting edge of a container, opening, or hollow.

ex.en: My lips felt dry after walking in the wind.
ex.zh: 在风中走了一阵后，我觉得嘴唇很干。

ex.en: Clear face coverings can improve communication for people who rely on watching lips to understand speech.
ex.zh: 透明面罩可以帮助那些依靠观察嘴唇来理解话语的人更顺畅地交流。

col: the lip of a cup｜杯口边缘
tip: 上下嘴唇合称lips；lip也可指容器等的边沿。

senses.en: Alive now, rather than dead or without life.
Money earned to pay for everyday needs.
The way people live and meet their everyday needs.

ex.en: The pond is full of tiny living creatures.
ex.zh: 池塘里满是微小的生物。

ex.en: Rising housing costs make it harder for young adults to earn a decent living in major cities.
ex.zh: 住房成本上涨，使年轻人在大城市更难挣到足以过上体面生活的收入。

tip: living可放名词前；alive通常作表语或后置修饰。

senses.en: money borrowed and expected to be paid back
the temporary use of something belonging to someone else
to give money or something temporarily, expecting its return

ex.en: We took out a loan to repair the roof.
ex.zh: 我们申请了一笔贷款来修屋顶。

ex.en: Affordable student loans can widen access to university, although repayment may create financial pressure after graduation.
ex.zh: 负担得起的学生贷款可以扩大大学入学机会，但毕业后的还款可能带来经济压力。

col: take out a loan｜申请贷款
tip: loan作动词意为借出，不是借入。

senses.en: The place where something is or where something happens.
A place outside a studio where filming takes place.

ex.en: This cafe has a lovely location beside the river.
ex.zh: 这家咖啡馆坐落在河边，位置很不错。

ex.en: The location of affordable housing strongly influences residents' access to schools, healthcare, and employment opportunities.
ex.zh: 保障性住房的位置会显著影响居民获得教育、医疗服务和就业机会的便利程度。

tip: on location指在摄影棚外实地拍摄。

senses.en: The fact of no longer having someone or something.
Money lost when costs are higher than income.
A defeat in a game or competition.

ex.en: She reported the loss of her wallet yesterday.
ex.zh: 她昨天报失了钱包。

ex.en: The loss of natural habitats threatens biodiversity and can weaken ecosystems that support local agriculture.
ex.zh: 自然栖息地的丧失威胁生物多样性，也可能削弱支撑当地农业的生态系统。

col: at a loss｜亏本地；不知所措
tip: loss是名词，lose是动词，过去式和过去分词为lost。

senses.en: Relating to the moon.
Based on the changing phases of the moon.

ex.en: We watched the lunar eclipse from our garden.
ex.zh: 我们在花园里观看了月食。

ex.en: Research on lunar rocks helps scientists understand how the moon and the early solar system developed.
ex.zh: 对月球岩石的研究有助于科学家了解月球及早期太阳系的演变。

tip: lunar指月亮的；solar指太阳的。

senses.en: the larger part of a group, exceeding half its members
the extra votes by which one candidate or side wins

ex.en: The majority of our neighbours have dogs or cats.
ex.zh: 我们的邻居大多数都养狗或猫。

ex.en: The majority of respondents supported greater investment in public transport rather than the construction of new roads.
ex.zh: 大多数受访者支持增加公共交通投资，而非修建新道路。

col: the vast majority of｜……的绝大多数
tip: the majority of接复数名词时，谓语通常用复数。

senses.en: Products applied to the face to change or enhance appearance.
The parts or qualities that together form something.

ex.en: She keeps her make-up in a small blue bag.
ex.zh: 她把化妆品放在一个蓝色小包里。

ex.en: The social make-up of a neighbourhood can change significantly as new housing attracts different residents.
ex.zh: 随着新建住房吸引不同的居民，一个社区的社会构成可能显著改变。

tip: 名词也写作makeup；动词短语make up不加连字符。

senses.en: A very large, impressive house.

ex.en: An enormous mansion stood behind the tall iron gates.
ex.zh: 高高的铁门后矗立着一座巨大的宅邸。

ex.en: The historic mansion has been converted into a museum to preserve the region's cultural heritage.
ex.zh: 这座历史悠久的宅邸已被改建为博物馆，以保护当地的文化遗产。

col: a sprawling mansion｜占地广阔的豪宅
tip: 通常指大型豪宅，不是普通办公大厦。
教材补充词；首次出现于高一下，来源：必修第三册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: the legally or socially recognised relationship between two spouses
a successful combination of different things

ex.en: Their marriage grew stronger as they learned to listen.
ex.zh: 随着他们学会倾听，婚姻关系变得更加稳固。

ex.en: Changing attitudes towards marriage have influenced household structures and housing demand in many societies.
ex.zh: 在许多社会中，人们对婚姻态度的变化影响了家庭结构和住房需求。

col: marriage to someone｜与某人的婚姻
tip: marriage指婚姻关系；wedding主要指婚礼。

senses.en: a large amount of something gathered together
the amount of matter in an object
involving or affecting very large numbers of people

ex.en: A mass of tangled cables lay behind the desk.
ex.zh: 书桌后面堆着一大团缠在一起的电线。

ex.en: Mass production has made household goods more affordable, but it can also increase waste and resource consumption.
ex.zh: 大规模生产使家居用品更便宜，但也可能增加废弃物和资源消耗。

tip: 物理学中mass指质量，weight指重量，二者不同。

senses.en: A substance used to make things, including cloth.
Information or ideas used for study or creative work.
Relating to physical possessions, or significant enough to matter.

ex.en: This bag is made from a strong waterproof material.
ex.zh: 这个包用结实的防水材料制成。

ex.en: Using recycled material in construction can reduce waste and lower demand for newly extracted natural resources.
ex.zh: 在建筑中使用再生材料可以减少废弃物，并降低对新开采自然资源的需求。

tip: 资料义通常不可数；多种材料可用materials。

senses.en: Relating to the mind and emotional wellbeing.

senses.zh: 脑力的；在头脑中进行的
senses.en: Using thought rather than physical action or written calculation.

ex.en: A quiet walk helps me protect my mental health.
ex.zh: 安静地散步有助于我保持心理健康。

ex.en: Employers should give mental wellbeing the same priority as physical safety when designing workplace policies.
ex.zh: 雇主制定职场政策时，应将心理健康与人身安全放在同等重要的位置。

tip: mental侧重心理或脑力；口语中形容人疯狂可能冒犯。

senses.en: Cheerful and full of enjoyment.

ex.en: Their merry laughter filled the kitchen as they baked.
ex.zh: 他们烘焙时，欢快的笑声充满了厨房。

ex.en: Community festivals create a merry atmosphere that encourages residents of different ages to interact and build friendships.
ex.zh: 社区节庆营造欢乐的氛围，鼓励不同年龄的居民交流并建立友谊。

tip: 常形容欢庆气氛；make merry意为欢庆作乐。
教材补充词；首次出现于高一下，来源：必修第二册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: An electric oven that heats food using electromagnetic waves
To cook or heat food in a microwave oven
A short electromagnetic wave used for heating and communication

ex.en: I heated yesterday's soup in the microwave for lunch.
ex.zh: 我用微波炉热了昨天的汤，当作午餐。

ex.en: Using a microwave to reheat small portions can consume less energy than using a conventional oven.
ex.zh: 用微波炉加热少量食物，比使用普通烤箱可能更节能。

col: microwave food｜用微波炉加热食物
tip: 作动词可直接接食物：microwave the soup。

senses.en: Twelve o'clock at night, when one day ends and another begins.

ex.en: We stayed awake until midnight watching the snow fall.
ex.zh: 我们一直醒着看雪，直到午夜。

ex.en: Extending public transport services beyond midnight would benefit shift workers who currently rely on expensive taxi journeys.
ex.zh: 将公共交通服务延长至午夜之后，将有利于目前依赖昂贵出租车出行的轮班工作者。

tip: 在午夜用at midnight，不用in midnight。
教材补充词；首次出现于高一下，来源：必修第三册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: Not severe or strong in effect
Pleasantly warm rather than cold
Not strong or spicy in flavour

ex.en: I have a mild headache, so I'll rest briefly.
ex.zh: 我有点头痛，所以要稍微休息一下。

ex.en: Even mild air pollution can affect vulnerable groups, making regular monitoring essential in densely populated cities.
ex.zh: 即使轻度空气污染也会影响易受伤害的群体，因此人口密集的城市必须定期监测空气质量。

tip: mild 可形容症状、天气和味道，不等于“无害”。

senses.en: relating to armed forces or their activities
a country's armed forces, considered as a group

ex.en: We watched military helicopters carry supplies to the island.
ex.zh: 我们看着军用直升机把物资运往岛上。

ex.en: Governments must balance military spending with investment in essential public services such as healthcare and education.
ex.zh: 政府必须平衡军事开支与医疗、教育等基本公共服务的投入。

tip: 作名词指整体军队时，通常用the military。
教材补充词；首次出现于高一下，来源：必修第三册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.zh: 少数民族；少数派；少数人

tip: 教材补充词；首次出现于高一下，来源：必修第三册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

tip: 教材补充词；首次出现于高一下，来源：必修第三册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

tip: 教材补充词；首次出现于高一下，来源：必修第三册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: To regularly check something for changes, progress, or problems.
A screen displaying information, or a device checking conditions.

ex.en: The nurse monitored my temperature throughout the night.
ex.zh: 护士整晚都在监测我的体温。

ex.en: Governments should monitor air quality regularly to assess whether environmental policies are effectively reducing pollution.
ex.zh: 政府应定期监测空气质量，以评估环境政策是否有效减少了污染。

col: monitor air quality｜监测空气质量
tip: 作动词可直接接宾语：monitor changes监测变化。

senses.en: concerning right and wrong, or following accepted standards of goodness
a lesson about right and wrong learned from a story

ex.en: Returning the lost wallet was clearly the moral choice.
ex.zh: 归还丢失的钱包显然是合乎道德的选择。

ex.en: Companies have a moral responsibility to ensure that their suppliers provide safe working conditions.
ex.zh: 企业在道义上有责任确保其供应商提供安全的工作环境。

col: the moral of the story｜故事的寓意
tip: moral指道德；morale指士气，注意拼写区别。

senses.en: Used to add another fact supporting what was just said.

ex.en: The flat is spacious; moreover, it has a balcony.
ex.zh: 这套公寓很宽敞，而且还有一个阳台。

ex.en: Public parks provide space for exercise; moreover, they can strengthen community ties by encouraging informal social interaction.
ex.zh: 公共公园提供锻炼场所；此外，它们还可通过促进非正式的社交互动来加强社区联系。

col: moreover, it is important to｜此外，重要的是要
moreover, there is evidence that｜而且，有证据表明
tip: 正式递进副词；连接独立句时，前用句号或分号。
教材补充词；首次出现于高一下，来源：必修第二册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

tip: 教材补充词；首次出现于高一下，来源：必修第二册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: body tissue that tightens and relaxes to produce movement
power or influence used to achieve something

ex.en: I pulled a muscle while lifting a heavy box.
ex.zh: 我搬一个重箱子时拉伤了肌肉。

ex.en: Regular strength training builds muscle and helps older adults maintain balance and independence in daily life.
ex.zh: 规律的力量训练能增强肌肉，帮助老年人在日常生活中保持平衡和独立。

tip: muscle中的c不发音；pull a muscle指拉伤肌肉。
教材补充词；首次出现于高一下，来源：必修第三册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

tip: 教材补充词；首次出现于高一下，来源：必修第三册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: The person or voice telling a story

ex.en: The narrator's gentle voice helped me fall asleep.
ex.zh: 旁白者轻柔的声音帮助我入睡。

ex.en: An unreliable narrator encourages readers to question events and consider how personal perspectives shape their understanding of reality.
ex.zh: 不可靠的叙述者促使读者质疑事件，并思考个人视角如何塑造对现实的理解。

tip: 叙述者不一定是作者；小说中可由虚构人物担任。
教材补充词；首次出现于高一下，来源：必修第三册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: tidy and carefully arranged
clever, simple, and effective

ex.en: She keeps her gardening tools in neat rows.
ex.zh: 她把园艺工具摆放得整整齐齐。

ex.en: Keeping shared workspaces neat can improve efficiency by making essential equipment easier to locate.
ex.zh: 保持共用工作空间整洁，可以让必要设备更容易找到，从而提高效率。

col: a neat solution｜巧妙的解决办法
tip: neat除指整洁，也可形容办法巧妙、简洁。

senses.en: A system of connected people, things or places.
A group of broadcasting stations sharing programmes.
To meet people and develop useful professional relationships.

ex.en: Our home network connects three laptops and a printer.
ex.zh: 我们的家庭网络连接着三台笔记本电脑和一台打印机。

ex.en: An efficient public transport network can reduce traffic congestion and improve access to employment.
ex.zh: 高效的公共交通网络可以缓解交通拥堵，并让人们更方便地前往工作地点。

col: network with colleagues｜与同行建立联系
tip: network强调多个节点之间相互连接。
教材补充词；首次出现于高一下，来源：必修第二册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

tip: 教材补充词；首次出现于高一下，来源：必修第二册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: not in or to any place

ex.en: There was nowhere to sit on the crowded train.
ex.zh: 拥挤的火车上没有地方可坐。

ex.en: Without affordable housing, some low-income families have nowhere to live despite having regular paid employment.
ex.zh: 如果缺乏可负担的住房，一些低收入家庭即使有固定工作，也无处居住。

col: in the middle of nowhere｜在偏僻之地
tip: 本身含否定意义：I have nowhere to go。

senses.en: Something you must do for legal or moral reasons

ex.en: You have no obligation to buy anything here.
ex.zh: 你没有义务在这里购买任何东西。

ex.en: Employers have a legal obligation to provide safe working conditions and protect employees from preventable harm.
ex.zh: 雇主有法律义务提供安全的工作条件，并保护员工免受可预防的伤害。

tip: 常用have an obligation to do，表示有义务做。

senses.en: to watch carefully or notice something
to follow a rule or practise a custom
to make a comment about something

ex.en: We observed a tiny bird building its nest outside.
ex.zh: 我们观察到一只小鸟正在外面筑巢。

ex.en: Students who observe wildlife directly often develop a deeper understanding of how ecosystems function.
ex.zh: 直接观察野生动物的学生往往能更深入地理解生态系统如何运作。

tip: observe sb doing sth 表示观察到某人正在做某事。

senses.en: Happen, especially at a particular time or place.
Exist or be found in a particular place or situation.
Come into someone's mind as an idea or thought.

ex.en: Power cuts often occur here during heavy winter storms.
ex.zh: 冬季强风暴来袭时，这里经常停电。

ex.en: Traffic accidents are more likely to occur when drivers are tired or distracted by mobile phones.
ex.zh: 驾驶员疲劳或因手机分心时，交通事故更容易发生。

tip: 不用于被动语态；过去式occurred，分词occurring。

senses.en: Strange or different from what is expected.
Not divisible by two without a remainder.
Occasional rather than regular or frequent.

ex.en: There is an odd smell coming from the fridge.
ex.zh: 冰箱里传出一股怪味。

ex.en: It may seem odd that some rapidly growing cities still lack reliable access to clean drinking water.
ex.zh: 一些快速发展的城市仍无法稳定获得清洁饮用水，这可能显得令人费解。

tip: the odd加单数名词常表示偶尔的某事。
教材补充词；首次出现于高一下，来源：必修第三册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: Continuing to happen or develop, rather than being finished.

ex.en: The ongoing repairs mean we cannot use the kitchen.
ex.zh: 维修仍在进行，所以我们没法使用厨房。

ex.en: Ongoing research into renewable energy is essential for reducing dependence on fossil fuels and limiting environmental damage.
ex.zh: 持续开展可再生能源研究，对减少化石燃料依赖和限制环境损害至关重要。

col: an ongoing investigation｜正在进行的调查
tip: 强调尚在持续，不等于即将发生的upcoming。

senses.en: Medical treatment involving cutting into the body.
The functioning or management of a machine, system, or business.
A planned activity involving several people working together.

ex.en: My aunt is recovering well after her knee operation.
ex.zh: 我姑姑膝盖手术后恢复得很好。

ex.en: The successful operation of public transport systems depends on reliable funding and careful long-term planning.
ex.zh: 公共交通系统的成功运作有赖于可靠的资金支持和周密的长期规划。

tip: 手术部位用on连接：an operation on the knee。

senses.en: Something you can choose from a range of possibilities.
The right or opportunity to choose whether to do something.

ex.en: Taking the bus is our cheapest option today.
ex.zh: 今天乘公交车是我们最便宜的选择。

ex.en: Remote working gives employees the option to live further from expensive city centres without changing jobs.
ex.zh: 远程办公让员工可以选择住在远离高房价市中心的地方，而不必换工作。

col: have no option but to｜别无选择只能
keep your options open｜保留选择余地
the option to buy｜购买的选择权
tip: option指可选方案；have no option but to后接动词原形。

senses.en: the curved path of an object moving around another in space
to move around a planet, star, or other object in space

ex.en: We watched an animation showing the satellite's orbit.
ex.zh: 我们观看了一段展示卫星运行轨道的动画。

ex.en: Satellites that orbit the Earth provide essential data for weather forecasting, disaster monitoring, and climate research.
ex.zh: 绕地球运行的卫星为天气预报、灾害监测和气候研究提供必要数据。

tip: 动词可直接接天体：orbit the Earth，无须加 around。
教材补充词；首次出现于高一下，来源：必修第三册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: existing at the beginning, before any changes
new and different rather than copied from something else
the first version from which copies are made

ex.en: The kitchen still has its original wooden floor.
ex.zh: 厨房仍保留着原来的木地板。

ex.en: Schools should encourage original thinking rather than reward students only for repeating information from textbooks.
ex.zh: 学校应鼓励独创性思考，而不是只奖励复述课本知识的学生。

tip: 可指最初的，也可指原创的；看语境区分。

senses.en: If this does not happen or is not done.
In all other ways apart from the one mentioned.
In a different way or with a different result.

ex.en: Take an umbrella; otherwise, you will get wet.
ex.zh: 带把伞吧，否则你会淋湿的。

ex.en: Cities must invest in reliable public transport; otherwise, more residents may choose to drive.
ex.zh: 城市必须投资建设可靠的公共交通，否则更多居民可能选择开车。

col: unless otherwise stated｜除非另有说明
otherwise healthy｜除此之外身体健康
tip: 表示“否则”时，书面语常在前面用分号。

senses.en: Used with to for advice, duty, or the right action.
Used with to to express what is likely or expected.

ex.en: You ought to take an umbrella; those clouds look dark.
ex.zh: 你应该带把伞，那些云看起来很阴沉。

ex.en: Governments ought to ensure that all children have access to quality education, regardless of family income.
ex.zh: 政府应确保所有儿童都能接受优质教育，不受家庭收入影响。

col: ought not to do｜不应该做
ought to have done｜本应该做
tip: ought是情态动词，后接to do；否定为ought not to。

senses.en: in or to a foreign country
located in, coming from, or relating to foreign countries

ex.en: My cousin moved overseas and calls us every weekend.
ex.zh: 我表亲搬到了国外，每个周末都给我们打电话。

ex.en: Studying overseas can broaden students' perspectives, although adapting to a different culture often takes time.
ex.zh: 出国留学能拓宽学生的视野，不过适应不同文化往往需要时间。

tip: 作副词前不加to：go overseas；也可修饰名词。

senses.en: A gas needed by most living things for life.

ex.en: The nurse gave him oxygen through a clear plastic mask.
ex.zh: 护士通过透明塑料面罩给他输氧。

ex.en: Pollution can reduce oxygen levels in rivers, making it difficult for fish and other aquatic organisms to survive.
ex.zh: 污染会降低河流中的含氧量，使鱼类和其他水生生物难以生存。

tip: oxygen是不可数名词，不说an oxygen。

senses.en: An organised procession of people or vehicles watched by spectators.
To walk together in an organised public procession.
To show something publicly, often to attract admiration.

ex.en: Children waved flags as the parade passed our balcony.
ex.zh: 游行队伍经过我们的阳台时，孩子们挥动着旗帜。

ex.en: A cultural parade allows communities to celebrate their traditions and share them with people from different backgrounds.
ex.zh: 文化游行让各社区能够庆祝自身传统，并与不同背景的人分享这些传统。

col: parade through the streets｜列队穿过街道
tip: parade重在列队展示；抗议游行常用march。

senses.en: Express the same meaning using different words.
A version expressing the same meaning in different words.

ex.en: Could you paraphrase that explanation so I can understand?
ex.zh: 你能换种说法解释一下，让我听懂吗？

ex.en: Students should learn to paraphrase sources accurately while acknowledging the original authors in their academic writing.
ex.zh: 学生应学会在学术写作中准确改述资料内容，同时注明原作者。

col: paraphrase a passage｜改述一段文字
paraphrase in your own words｜用自己的话改述
tip: 改述须保留原意；summarize则侧重概括要点。

senses.en: used to refer to one specific person, thing, or situation
greater or more noticeable than usual
having strong preferences and being difficult to satisfy

ex.en: Are you looking for any particular book today?
ex.zh: 你今天是在找某一本特定的书吗？

ex.en: Schools should pay particular attention to students who lack access to digital resources at home.
ex.zh: 学校应特别关注那些在家中无法获得数字资源的学生。

col: a particular reason｜某个特定原因
tip: in particular意为尤其；be particular about表示对……讲究。
教材补充词；首次出现于高一下，来源：必修第三册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

tip: 教材补充词；首次出现于高一下，来源：必修第三册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: A regular or repeated way something happens or is done.
An arrangement of shapes, lines, or colours forming a design.

ex.en: My cat follows the same sleeping pattern every day.
ex.zh: 我的猫每天都遵循相同的睡眠规律。

ex.en: Researchers analyse patterns of energy consumption to identify opportunities for reducing waste in households.
ex.zh: 研究人员分析能源消耗模式，以寻找减少家庭能源浪费的机会。

col: a pattern of behaviour｜行为模式
follow a pattern｜遵循某种模式
tip: 表示规律常用a pattern of＋名词。

senses.en: an amount expressed as a fraction of one hundred

ex.en: What percentage of your monthly income goes on rent?
ex.zh: 你每月收入的百分之多少用于付房租？

ex.en: The percentage of households using renewable energy has increased as installation costs have fallen in recent years.
ex.zh: 近年来，随着安装成本下降，使用可再生能源的家庭比例有所上升。

col: a high percentage of｜很高比例的
a small percentage of｜小部分的
tip: 数字后用percent；谈比例用percentage。

senses.en: How well a person, organisation or machine does something.
An occasion when someone entertains an audience by performing.
The act of carrying out a task or duty.

ex.en: The coach praised our performance after the football match.
ex.zh: 足球赛后，教练表扬了我们的表现。

ex.en: Regular feedback can improve employee performance by helping workers understand expectations and address specific weaknesses.
ex.zh: 定期反馈能帮助员工了解工作要求并改进具体不足，从而提升工作表现。

tip: 表示整体表现通常不可数；一场演出用a performance。

senses.en: agreement allowing someone to do something

ex.en: You need permission to borrow your sister's bicycle.
ex.zh: 你得先征得姐姐同意，才能借她的自行车。

ex.en: Researchers must obtain permission from participants before collecting personal information for a scientific study.
ex.zh: 研究人员为科学研究收集个人信息前，必须征得参与者同意。

col: permission to do something｜做某事的许可
tip: 通常不可数；说give permission，不加a。

senses.en: to officially allow someone to do something
an official document allowing a particular activity
to make an action or situation possible

ex.en: The museum permits visitors to take photos without flash.
ex.zh: 这家博物馆允许游客在不开闪光灯的情况下拍照。

ex.en: Local authorities should permit new housing developments only when adequate transport and healthcare services are available.
ex.zh: 地方政府只有在交通和医疗服务充足时，才应批准新的住宅开发项目。

col: permit someone to do something｜允许某人做某事
tip: 动词重音在后，名词在前；permit sb to do。
教材补充词；首次出现于高一下，来源：必修第二册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

tip: 教材补充词；首次出现于高一下，来源：必修第二册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: The study of knowledge, existence, reality, and moral values
A set of beliefs that guides actions and decisions

ex.en: My sister studies philosophy and enjoys discussing difficult questions.
ex.zh: 我姐姐学习哲学，喜欢讨论难解的问题。

ex.en: Studying philosophy can help students question assumptions and develop stronger arguments about complex ethical issues.
ex.zh: 学习哲学有助于学生质疑既有假设，并就复杂的伦理问题提出更有力的论证。

tip: 指学科通常不可数；指某套理念可用a philosophy。

senses.en: A medical doctor, especially one treating illness without surgery.

ex.en: The physician listened carefully as I described my symptoms.
ex.zh: 我描述症状时，医生认真地听着。

ex.en: Access to a qualified physician remains limited in remote areas, contributing to significant inequalities in healthcare.
ex.zh: 偏远地区获得合格医生诊治的机会仍然有限，这加剧了医疗服务方面的显著不平等。

col: primary care physician｜初级保健医生
tip: 美式常泛指医生；英式常指内科医生。

senses.en: A soft support for your head when resting or sleeping.

ex.en: She placed a fresh pillow on the guest bed.
ex.zh: 她在客床上放了一个干净的枕头。

ex.en: Choosing a supportive pillow may improve sleep quality by helping maintain a comfortable neck position.
ex.zh: 选择支撑性好的枕头，有助于保持舒适的颈部姿势，从而可能改善睡眠质量。

tip: pillow主要用于睡觉；cushion多指靠垫或坐垫。

senses.en: simple, without decoration or a pattern
easy to see or understand
a large area of flat land

ex.en: She chose a plain white shirt for the interview.
ex.zh: 她选了一件朴素的白衬衫去参加面试。

ex.en: Public health advice should use plain language so that everyone can understand essential information.
ex.zh: 公共卫生建议应使用浅显的语言，让每个人都能理解关键信息。

tip: plain可指无花纹；平原用名词plain。

senses.en: feeling happy or satisfied about something

ex.en: I'm really pleased with how the cake turned out.
ex.zh: 我对这个蛋糕做出来的效果非常满意。

ex.en: Residents were pleased that the council had created more green spaces for children to play safely.
ex.zh: 居民们很高兴，市政部门增设了更多绿地，让孩子们可以安全地玩耍。

col: pleased to meet you｜很高兴认识你
tip: 对结果满意用pleased with；听到喜讯用pleased to hear。

senses.en: the connected events that make up a story
a small piece of land used for a particular purpose
secretly plan something harmful or dishonest

ex.en: The film had a simple but exciting plot.
ex.zh: 这部电影的情节简单却扣人心弦。

ex.en: Community gardens allow residents to grow vegetables on a small plot, improving access to fresh food.
ex.zh: 社区花园让居民可以在一小块土地上种菜，更方便地获得新鲜食物。

col: a plot of land｜一小块土地
a garden plot｜一小块菜园地
plot against someone｜密谋对付某人
tip: plot指情节；作动词还可表示标绘数据。

senses.en: With something added to an amount or group.
An advantage or positive feature.
Greater than zero, especially when describing temperatures.

ex.en: The room costs sixty pounds plus breakfast each night.
ex.zh: 房间每晚六十英镑，早餐另收费。

ex.en: Affordable housing plus reliable public transport can make expanding cities more accessible to workers on modest incomes.
ex.zh: 经济适用的住房加上可靠的公共交通，能让收入不高的劳动者更容易在扩张中的城市生活。

tip: plus作名词表示优点时可数，如a big plus。

senses.en: Literature using carefully arranged language, rhythm, and imagery.
Beauty or emotional power resembling that of poems.

ex.en: She reads poetry aloud while her tea cools.
ex.zh: 她一边等茶凉下来，一边朗读诗歌。

ex.en: Studying poetry encourages students to explore complex emotions and appreciate the expressive possibilities of language.
ex.zh: 学习诗歌能鼓励学生探索复杂情感，并欣赏语言丰富的表达潜力。

tip: poetry不可数；一首诗用a poem，不用a poetry。

senses.en: A substance that can seriously harm or kill living things.
Harm living things or contaminate something with a toxic substance.
Make a relationship or situation unpleasant or harmful.

ex.en: Some garden plants contain poison, so keep pets away.
ex.zh: 有些园艺植物含有毒素，因此要让宠物远离。

ex.en: Toxic waste from poorly regulated factories can poison rivers, threatening wildlife and the health of nearby communities.
ex.zh: 监管不力的工厂排出的有毒废物可能污染河流，威胁野生动物和附近居民的健康。

col: poison the water supply｜污染供水
tip: poison 是名词或动词；“有毒的”用 poisonous。

senses.en: Containing a substance that can cause illness or death.
Extremely unkind or harmful to relationships.

ex.en: Some colourful berries are poisonous, so leave them alone.
ex.zh: 有些颜色鲜艳的浆果有毒，所以不要碰。

ex.en: Factories must prevent poisonous substances from entering rivers that supply drinking water to nearby communities.
ex.zh: 工厂必须防止有毒物质流入为周边社区提供饮用水的河流。

tip: poisonous指有毒；venomous强调咬刺注毒。

senses.en: A long, narrow stick or post, often used for support.
Either of two opposite ends of Earth, a magnet, or battery.
Either of two completely opposite positions or qualities.

ex.en: We used a long pole to support the tent.
ex.zh: 我们用一根长杆撑起帐篷。

ex.en: Climate change is affecting both poles, although the environmental consequences differ significantly between the two regions.
ex.zh: 气候变化正影响着南北两极，但两个地区面临的环境后果存在显著差异。

tip: pole与poll同音；地理名称the North Pole需大写。

senses.en: to arrange for something to happen later than originally planned

ex.en: We postponed our picnic because heavy rain was forecast.
ex.zh: 因为天气预报说有大雨，我们推迟了野餐。

ex.en: Local authorities decided to postpone construction until a full assessment of the environmental impact was completed.
ex.zh: 地方当局决定推迟施工，直到完成全面的环境影响评估。

col: postpone until further notice｜延期至另行通知
tip: 后接名词或动名词：postpone doing，不接to do。

senses.en: Worth a lot of money or deserving great care.
Deeply valued because of personal importance or limited availability.

ex.en: She keeps her precious necklace in a velvet box.
ex.zh: 她把珍贵的项链放在一个天鹅绒盒子里。

ex.en: Fresh water is a precious resource that requires careful management as populations grow and temperatures rise.
ex.zh: 随着人口增长和气温上升，淡水作为宝贵资源需要得到谨慎管理。

tip: 既可指金钱价值高，也可指感情上珍贵或资源稀缺。

senses.en: having a baby developing inside the body

ex.en: My cousin is pregnant and expects her baby in June.
ex.zh: 我表姐怀孕了，预产期在六月。

ex.en: Accessible healthcare helps pregnant women receive regular check-ups and reliable advice throughout their pregnancy.
ex.zh: 便捷可及的医疗服务有助于孕妇在整个孕期获得定期检查和可靠的建议。

tip: 表示怀孕多久可说six months pregnant。

senses.en: Keep something safe, unchanged, or in good condition
Treat food so it stays safe to eat longer
An area where wildlife and natural habitats are protected

ex.en: We preserve old family photographs in a special album.
ex.zh: 我们把家里的老照片保存在一本专用相册里。

ex.en: Local authorities should preserve historic buildings while adapting them to meet the needs of modern communities.
ex.zh: 地方政府应保护历史建筑，同时改造它们以满足现代社区的需求。

col: preserve cultural heritage｜保护文化遗产
tip: preserve强调保持原状；保藏食物也用它。

senses.en: To stop something happening or someone doing something.

ex.en: This tight lid will prevent the soup from spilling.
ex.zh: 这个严实的盖子能防止汤洒出来。

ex.en: Investing in early health education can help prevent chronic diseases and reduce future pressure on public healthcare services.
ex.zh: 投资早期健康教育有助于预防慢性病，并减轻公共医疗服务未来的压力。

col: prevent someone from doing｜阻止某人做某事
tip: 用prevent sb from doing，不用prevent sb to do。

senses.en: happening or existing before the time or thing being discussed

ex.en: The previous tenant left some plants on the balcony.
ex.zh: 上一位租客在阳台上留下了几盆植物。

ex.en: Previous studies suggest that regular physical activity can improve concentration and academic performance among school children.
ex.zh: 先前的研究表明，经常运动能提高学龄儿童的专注力和学习成绩。

tip: previous是形容词；表示“以前”用副词previously。

senses.en: A belief or rule that guides decisions and behaviour.
A basic truth explaining how something works.

ex.en: I refused the extra money as a matter of principle.
ex.zh: 出于原则，我拒绝了那笔额外的钱。

ex.en: The principle of equal opportunity should guide policies designed to improve access to higher education.
ex.zh: 旨在改善高等教育入学机会的政策应以机会平等原则为指导。

col: basic principle｜基本原则；基本原理
tip: 勿混principal：它可指“主要的”或“校长”。

senses.en: Freedom from unwanted access to personal information or private life.
The state of being alone and free from disturbance.

ex.en: Please knock before entering; everyone needs a little privacy.
ex.zh: 进门前请敲门；每个人都需要一点私人空间。

ex.en: Governments should protect individual privacy while allowing researchers to use anonymous data for public health studies.
ex.zh: 政府应保护个人隐私，同时允许研究人员使用匿名数据开展公共卫生研究。

col: in the privacy of your home｜在家中不受打扰地
tip: 通常不可数；英美发音首音节差异明显。

senses.en: an established series of actions for completing a task
a medical action performed to diagnose or treat a condition

ex.en: The receptionist explained the procedure for joining the gym.
ex.zh: 接待员说明了办理健身房会员的手续。

ex.en: Every laboratory should establish a clear procedure for handling chemicals safely and disposing of waste responsibly.
ex.zh: 每个实验室都应制定明确规程，以安全处理化学品并妥善处置废物。

tip: procedure 强调规定步骤；process 更侧重整个过程。

senses.en: Relating to skilled work or an activity done for payment.
Showing the skill and behaviour expected of a trained worker.
Someone trained for skilled work or paid to perform.

ex.en: We hired a professional photographer for our wedding.
ex.zh: 我们为婚礼聘请了一位专业摄影师。

ex.en: Continuous professional development helps teachers adapt their methods to changing student needs and new educational technologies.
ex.zh: 持续的专业发展帮助教师调整教学方法，以适应学生需求的变化和新的教育技术。

tip: 与amateur对比强调职业；形容态度时强调专业得体。

senses.en: Money earned after paying the costs of a business.
To gain money or an advantage from something.

ex.en: The bakery made a small profit this month.
ex.zh: 这家面包店这个月赚了一点钱。

ex.en: Companies should invest part of their profit in cleaner technology to reduce environmental damage.
ex.zh: 企业应将部分利润投入更清洁的技术，以减少环境损害。

tip: profit是扣除成本后的利润，不等于收入revenue。

senses.en: to encourage something to develop or become more widely accepted
to give someone a higher position at work
to attract attention to something to increase interest or sales

ex.en: Our local club promotes cycling through free weekend rides.
ex.zh: 我们当地的俱乐部通过免费的周末骑行活动推广骑车。

ex.en: Schools can promote healthier lifestyles by providing nutritious meals and encouraging students to take regular exercise.
ex.zh: 学校可以通过提供营养餐并鼓励学生定期锻炼来倡导更健康的生活方式。

col: promote economic growth｜促进经济增长
be promoted to manager｜获晋升为经理
tip: 晋升到某职位用be promoted to＋职位。

senses.en: A suggested plan for others to consider.
An act of asking someone to marry you.

ex.en: Everyone liked my proposal to turn the spare room into an office.
ex.zh: 大家都喜欢我把空房间改成办公室的提议。

ex.en: The council is considering a proposal to replace an unused car park with affordable housing.
ex.zh: 地方议会正在考虑一项将闲置停车场改建为经济适用住房的方案。

col: put forward a proposal｜提出方案
a proposal to do something｜做某事的提议
tip: proposal to do表示做某事的提议，通常为可数名词。

senses.en: An expression or action showing strong disagreement or opposition.
Express strong disagreement with something.

ex.en: Residents held a peaceful protest outside the town hall.
ex.zh: 居民在市政厅外举行了一场和平抗议。

ex.en: Citizens may protest against environmental policies that fail to protect local forests and water supplies.
ex.zh: 公民可能会抗议那些未能保护当地森林和水源的环境政策。

tip: 所列为名词音；动词英音/prəˈtest/，常接against。

senses.en: A place serving alcoholic drinks and often meals, especially in Britain.

ex.en: We had vegetable soup at the village pub.
ex.zh: 我们在村里的酒馆喝了蔬菜汤。

ex.en: In some rural communities, the local pub provides an important meeting place for residents.
ex.zh: 在一些乡村社区，当地酒馆为居民提供了重要的聚会场所。

tip: pub多见于英国语境，常供应餐食，不等于旅馆。
教材补充词；首次出现于高一下，来源：必修第三册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

tip: 教材补充词；首次出现于高一下，来源：必修第三册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: A game or problem that tests your thinking skills.
Something that is difficult to understand or explain.
To make someone feel confused because something is difficult to understand.

ex.en: We finished the puzzle together on the kitchen table.
ex.zh: 我们在厨房桌上一起完成了拼图。

ex.en: The relationship between income and personal happiness remains a puzzle that researchers approach from several different perspectives.
ex.zh: 收入与个人幸福感之间的关系仍是一个谜，研究人员正从多个不同角度探索它。

tip: puzzled形容人感到困惑；puzzling形容事物令人困惑。

senses.en: a structure with triangular sides meeting at a point
a system with fewer members at each successively higher level

ex.en: We built a small pyramid out of wooden blocks.
ex.zh: 我们用木块搭了一座小金字塔。

ex.en: The management pyramid in many organisations places a small group of executives above numerous employees.
ex.zh: 许多机构的金字塔式管理结构将少数高管置于众多员工之上。

tip: 既指古代金字塔，也指几何中的棱锥体。

senses.en: To repeat someone's exact words in speech or writing.
To state the price you will charge for something.
Repeated words from a source, or a stated price.

ex.en: My sister loves to quote lines from old films.
ex.zh: 我姐姐很喜欢引用老电影里的台词。

ex.en: Students should quote reliable sources accurately and explain how the evidence supports their arguments in academic essays.
ex.zh: 学生在学术论文中应准确引用可靠来源，并解释证据如何支持自己的论点。

col: quote someone a price｜向某人报价
tip: quote引用原话；paraphrase用自己的话转述。

senses.en: The extent or variety of things within certain limits.
To vary between particular limits.
A connected group of mountains.

ex.en: This shop sells a wide range of fresh fruit.
ex.zh: 这家商店出售种类繁多的新鲜水果。

ex.en: Universities should offer a broader range of courses to meet the changing needs of employers.
ex.zh: 大学应提供更广泛的课程，以满足雇主不断变化的需求。

col: a wide range of｜种类繁多的
range from A to B｜从A到B不等
tip: range from A to B表示变化范围；山脉用名词。

senses.en: How often something happens or how quickly something changes.
An amount charged or paid for a particular unit.
To judge the quality, value, or level of something.

ex.en: This hotel offers a cheaper rate during the winter.
ex.zh: 这家酒店冬季的房价更便宜。

ex.en: Cities with reliable public transport often experience lower rates of car ownership, reducing congestion and improving air quality.
ex.zh: 拥有可靠公共交通的城市往往汽车拥有率较低，从而减少拥堵并改善空气质量。

tip: rate可指比率或单位费用；评价某物用rate。
教材补充词；首次出现于高一下，来源：必修第二册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: return to health or a normal condition after difficulty
get back something lost, stolen, or spent

ex.en: It took several days to recover from the flu.
ex.zh: 流感过后，花了好几天才康复。

ex.en: Local economies often recover more quickly when governments provide timely support for small businesses.
ex.zh: 政府及时为小企业提供支持时，当地经济往往恢复得更快。

col: recover from an illness｜病后康复
recover lost data｜恢复丢失的数据
tip: 从疾病或挫折中恢复用recover from。

senses.en: to process used materials so they can be used again

ex.en: We recycle glass bottles at the centre near our house.
ex.zh: 我们把玻璃瓶送到家附近的回收中心回收。

ex.en: Cities can reduce landfill waste by making it easier for residents to recycle everyday packaging.
ex.zh: 城市可以通过方便居民回收日常包装来减少填埋垃圾。

col: recycle household waste｜回收生活垃圾
tip: recycle指回收加工再利用，reuse侧重直接再次使用。
教材补充词；首次出现于高一下，来源：必修第三册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: an area of a country or the world
a particular area of the body

ex.en: This region is famous for its apples and cheese.
ex.zh: 这个地区以苹果和奶酪闻名。

ex.en: Improved transport links could attract more businesses to the region and create jobs for local residents.
ex.zh: 改善交通联系可以吸引更多企业进入该地区，并为当地居民创造就业机会。

tip: in the region of接金额等，表示“大约”。

senses.en: often or at repeated intervals
with equal spaces or a consistent pattern

ex.en: We regularly walk along the river after dinner.
ex.zh: 我们经常晚饭后沿着河边散步。

ex.en: People who exercise regularly are more likely to maintain good physical health as they grow older.
ex.zh: 经常锻炼的人随着年龄增长，更有可能保持良好的身体健康。

tip: 可表示经常，也可表示固定间隔；不一定指每天。
教材补充词；首次出现于高一下，来源：必修第三册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: To refuse to accept, approve, or believe something.
To remove something because it is faulty or unsuitable.
An item not accepted because it fails to meet standards.

ex.en: The shop rejected my offer for the old bicycle.
ex.zh: 店家拒绝了我对那辆旧自行车的出价。

ex.en: Local authorities may reject construction proposals if developers cannot demonstrate that nearby wildlife habitats will be protected.
ex.zh: 如果开发商无法证明附近的野生动物栖息地会得到保护，地方政府可能会否决建设方案。

tip: 动词重音在后；名词重音在前，读/ˈriːdʒekt/。

senses.en: The act of refusing to accept someone or something.
The body's immune response against transplanted tissue or an organ.

ex.en: After another rejection, she revised her job application.
ex.zh: 再次遭到拒绝后，她修改了自己的求职申请。

ex.en: Repeated rejection in the labour market can damage young people's confidence and discourage further job applications.
ex.zh: 在劳动力市场上屡遭拒绝，可能损害年轻人的信心，使他们不愿继续求职。

col: rejection of a proposal｜否决提案
tip: rejection of后接被拒绝的人、提议或事物。
教材补充词；首次出现于高一下，来源：必修第二册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: Comfort felt when worry or fear ends
A reduction in pain or discomfort
Help given to people suffering from disaster or poverty

ex.en: I sighed with relief when my missing cat returned.
ex.zh: 走失的猫回来时，我松了一口气。

ex.en: Rapid delivery of emergency relief can prevent further suffering in communities affected by severe flooding.
ex.zh: 迅速运送紧急救援物资可以避免遭受严重洪灾的社区承受更多苦难。

col: a sigh of relief｜如释重负的一声叹息
to someone's relief｜令某人宽慰的是
tip: relief是名词，relieve是动词；疼痛缓解用pain relief。

senses.en: belief in gods or spiritual powers, with related practices

ex.en: We learned about different religions at school today.
ex.zh: 今天我们在学校了解了不同的宗教。

ex.en: Schools can teach students about religion while encouraging respect for people with different beliefs.
ex.zh: 学校可以教授宗教知识，同时鼓励学生尊重持不同信仰的人。

tip: 泛指宗教时不可数；指某一种宗教时可数。
教材补充词；首次出现于高一下，来源：必修第三册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: Doing or saying something again, often several times

ex.en: Through daily repetition, I finally remembered the whole song.
ex.zh: 通过每天反复练习，我终于记住了整首歌。

ex.en: Regular repetition can help language learners remember new vocabulary, especially when combined with meaningful practice.
ex.zh: 定期重复有助于语言学习者记住新词汇，尤其是在结合有意义的练习时。

col: learn through repetition｜通过反复练习学习
tip: repetition强调重复；rehearsal指演出前的排练。

senses.en: To speak or act officially for someone or a group.
To stand for or show someone or something.
To amount to something or form part of a whole.

ex.en: My classmates chose me to represent them at the meeting.
ex.zh: 同学们选我代表他们参加会议。

ex.en: Elected councils should represent the interests of all residents, including those from disadvantaged backgrounds.
ex.zh: 民选议会应代表所有居民的利益，包括弱势群体的利益。

col: represent someone's interests｜代表某人的利益
represent a significant proportion｜占很大比例
tip: represent是动词；on behalf of是“代表”的介词短语。

senses.en: A country whose head of state is not a monarch.

ex.en: Our teacher explained how the country became a republic.
ex.zh: 老师讲解了这个国家如何成为共和国。

ex.en: In a republic, constitutional rules usually define the powers of the head of state and other public institutions.
ex.zh: 在共和国中，宪法规则通常规定国家元首及其他公共机构的权力。

col: a parliamentary republic｜议会制共和国
tip: 共和国没有君主，但并不必然实行民主制度。

senses.en: Arrange to keep something for a particular person or purpose.
A supply kept for use when needed.
An area where wildlife and natural habitats are protected.

ex.en: Could you reserve a table for us tonight?
ex.zh: 你能帮我们预订今晚的餐桌吗？

ex.en: Governments should maintain adequate food reserves to protect vulnerable communities during periods of severe drought.
ex.zh: 政府应保持充足的粮食储备，以便在严重干旱期间保护脆弱群体。

col: reserve something for someone｜为某人保留某物
tip: 动词常用 reserve sth for sb；储量常用 reserves。

senses.en: Someone who lives in a particular place.
Living or working regularly in a particular place.

ex.en: Every resident received a key to the shared garden.
ex.zh: 每位住户都拿到了一把公共花园的钥匙。

ex.en: Local residents should be consulted before major changes are made to roads and public spaces.
ex.zh: 在对道路和公共空间进行重大改造之前，应征求当地居民的意见。

tip: resident指人；residential形容住宅或居住区。

senses.en: To say or write something in reply.
To react to something through actions or physical changes.

ex.en: I asked about dinner, but nobody responded to my message.
ex.zh: 我发消息问晚饭怎么安排，却没人回复。

ex.en: Healthcare systems must respond quickly to changing population needs while maintaining high standards of care.
ex.zh: 医疗体系必须迅速回应不断变化的人口需求，同时维持高水平的医疗服务。

col: respond to a question｜回答问题
respond to treatment｜对治疗产生反应
tip: respond to后接回应对象，不能直接接宾语。

senses.en: Something said or written as an answer.
An action or change caused by an event or situation.

ex.en: I sent an invitation but haven't received a response yet.
ex.zh: 我发出了邀请，但还没有收到答复。

ex.en: A rapid response to disease outbreaks can protect vulnerable communities and reduce pressure on local hospitals.
ex.zh: 迅速应对疾病暴发能够保护脆弱群体，并减轻当地医院的压力。

col: in response to｜作为对……的回应
tip: response后通常接to，不接of。

senses.en: To stop working permanently, usually because of age.
To leave a competition before finishing it.

ex.en: My aunt plans to retire and spend more time gardening.
ex.zh: 我姑姑打算退休，多花些时间种花种菜。

ex.en: As life expectancy increases, some governments encourage people to retire later to reduce pressure on pension systems.
ex.zh: 随着预期寿命延长，一些政府鼓励人们推迟退休，以减轻养老金制度的压力。

col: retire from a race｜退出比赛
tip: retire是动词；“退休”这一名词用retirement。
教材补充词；首次出现于高一下，来源：必修第二册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

tip: 教材补充词；首次出现于高一下，来源：必修第三册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: to make a very loud, deep sound
a very loud, deep sound

ex.en: The lion roared, and its cubs huddled closer together.
ex.zh: 狮子吼了一声，幼狮们挤得更紧了。

ex.en: Aircraft engines roar above nearby homes, exposing residents to noise pollution that can affect sleep quality.
ex.zh: 飞机发动机在附近住宅上空轰鸣，使居民遭受可能影响睡眠质量的噪声污染。

col: a roar of applause｜雷鸣般的掌声
the roar of an engine｜发动机的轰鸣声
tip: 既可指狮子吼叫，也可指引擎轰鸣或人群欢呼。

senses.en: To cook food using dry heat, especially in an oven.
Cooked using dry heat in an oven or over a fire.
A large piece of roasted meat, or a meal containing it.

ex.en: We usually roast potatoes with garlic and fresh herbs.
ex.zh: 我们通常用大蒜和新鲜香草烤土豆。

ex.en: Families can roast seasonal vegetables at home to prepare nutritious meals without relying on highly processed foods.
ex.zh: 家庭可以在家烤时令蔬菜，做出营养丰富的饭菜，而不必依赖高度加工的食品。

tip: roast多用于肉和蔬菜；烤面包、蛋糕通常用bake。
教材补充词；首次出现于高一下，来源：必修第三册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

tip: 教材补充词；首次出现于高一下，来源：必修第三册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

tip: 教材补充词；首次出现于高一下，来源：必修第二册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: Connected with religion and deserving deep respect
Considered too important or valuable to change or harm

ex.en: Visitors remove their shoes before entering the sacred temple.
ex.zh: 游客进入这座神圣的寺庙前会脱鞋。

ex.en: Tourism can support local economies, but visitors must respect sacred places and religious customs.
ex.zh: 旅游业可以促进当地经济，但游客必须尊重圣地和宗教习俗。

col: hold something sacred｜视某物为神圣
tip: sacred可指宗教上的神圣，也指极珍视、不可侵犯。

senses.en: Travel across water in a boat or ship.
A large sheet of material that catches wind to move boats.

ex.en: We sailed across the lake on a sunny afternoon.
ex.zh: 一个晴朗的下午，我们乘船驶过湖面。

ex.en: Ships that sail through sensitive marine habitats should follow strict rules to protect wildlife.
ex.zh: 驶经敏感海洋栖息地的船只应遵守严格规定，以保护野生动物。

col: sail across the ocean｜航行穿越大洋
tip: 作动词不限于帆船，也可指轮船航行。
教材补充词；首次出现于高一下，来源：必修第三册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: Pleasure felt when needs, wishes, or expectations are fulfilled.
The act of meeting a need, demand, or requirement.

ex.en: He smiled with satisfaction after fixing the broken chair.
ex.zh: 修好那把坏椅子后，他满意地笑了。

ex.en: Greater job satisfaction can reduce staff turnover and encourage employees to contribute more actively to their organisations.
ex.zh: 更高的工作满意度可以减少人员流失，并鼓励员工更积极地为所在机构作贡献。

col: the satisfaction of basic needs｜基本需求的满足
tip: 通常不可数；满意某事常说satisfaction with。

senses.en: a reduction in the money, time, or resources used
money kept rather than spent, usually for future needs

ex.en: Buying a monthly pass gave me a useful saving.
ex.zh: 买月票让我省下了一笔实用的开支。

ex.en: Investing in efficient heating systems can produce significant energy savings for households over the long term.
ex.zh: 从长远来看，投资高效供暖系统能显著降低家庭能耗。

tip: 表示积蓄通常用复数savings；节省可用单数。
教材补充词；首次出现于高一下，来源：必修第三册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: to make someone feel frightened
a sudden feeling or period of fear

ex.en: Please knock gently so you don't scare the baby.
ex.zh: 请轻轻敲门，别吓到宝宝。

ex.en: Misleading reports about food safety can scare consumers and damage public confidence in local producers.
ex.zh: 有关食品安全的误导性报道可能吓到消费者，并损害公众对本地生产商的信任。

col: give someone a scare｜吓某人一跳
tip: scared形容人感到害怕；scary形容事物吓人。

senses.en: a view or situation that you see
the place where an event happens
a short part of a play or film

ex.en: The children playing by the lake made a peaceful scene.
ex.zh: 孩子们在湖边玩耍，构成了一幅宁静的画面。

ex.en: The film's opening scene highlights the challenges faced by families living in crowded urban neighbourhoods.
ex.zh: 影片的开场片段突出了居住在拥挤城市社区的家庭面临的挑战。

tip: scene可数；scenery指整体风景，不可数。

senses.en: A noticeable smell, especially a pleasant one.
A smell left behind that an animal can follow.
To detect something by its smell.

ex.en: The scent of fresh bread filled the kitchen.
ex.zh: 新鲜面包的香味弥漫了整个厨房。

ex.en: The scent of flowers can attract pollinators, helping many plant species reproduce and maintain healthy ecosystems.
ex.zh: 花香可以吸引传粉动物，帮助许多植物繁殖，并维持健康的生态系统。

col: follow a scent｜循着气味追踪
tip: scent常指香味，也指动物追踪的气味；c不发音。

senses.en: Money awarded to help someone pay for their studies.
Serious academic study or the knowledge gained through it.

ex.en: A scholarship helped Ravi pay for his university course.
ex.zh: 一笔奖学金帮助拉维支付了大学课程的费用。

ex.en: Universities should offer more scholarships to talented applicants from families with limited financial resources.
ex.zh: 大学应为经济条件有限的家庭中有才华的申请者提供更多奖学金。

tip: 指奖学金时可数；指学问或学术研究时不可数。

senses.en: To try to find or obtain something.
To try to do or achieve something.

ex.en: You should seek advice before buying a used car.
ex.zh: 买二手车之前，你应该征求意见。

ex.en: Many graduates seek employment abroad to gain professional experience and develop their language skills.
ex.zh: 许多毕业生到国外求职，以积累职业经验并提升语言技能。

tip: 过去式和过去分词均为sought；后直接接宾语。

senses.en: Choose someone or something carefully from available options.
Carefully chosen for special quality or suitability.

ex.en: Please select a fresh apple from the basket.
ex.zh: 请从篮子里挑选一个新鲜的苹果。

ex.en: Universities should select applicants using a range of criteria rather than relying entirely on examination results.
ex.zh: 大学应依据多种标准选拔申请者，而非完全依赖考试成绩。

col: select from a list｜从列表中选择
select someone for a role｜选某人担任角色
a select group｜精选的一群人
tip: select 比 choose 正式，常强调仔细挑选。

senses.zh: 感觉的；感官的；安装好（沒备或机器

tip: 教材补充词；首次出现于高一下，来源：必修第二册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: An ordered series of things, actions, or events.
To arrange things or events in a particular order.

ex.en: Arrange these pictures in the correct sequence before dinner.
ex.zh: 晚饭前把这些图片按正确顺序排好。

ex.en: Understanding the sequence of events helps researchers identify the factors that contributed to an environmental disaster.
ex.zh: 了解事件发生的先后顺序，有助于研究人员找出导致环境灾难的因素。

col: a sequence of events｜一连串事件
tip: a sequence of后接复数名词，表示一连串事物。

senses.en: several related things or events following one another
a set of programmes or books sharing characters or a subject

ex.en: A series of small delays made us miss lunch.
ex.zh: 接连几次小耽搁让我们错过了午饭。

ex.en: The university introduced a series of workshops to help students evaluate information found on social media.
ex.zh: 这所大学推出了一系列研讨课，帮助学生评估社交媒体上的信息。

col: a series of events｜一连串事件
a television series｜电视系列节目
tip: 单复数同形：a series；two series。

senses.en: Someone employed to do household work in another person's home

ex.en: The servant carried fresh towels into the guest bedroom.
ex.zh: 佣人把干净毛巾拿进了客房。

ex.en: In wealthy households of the past, servants often worked long hours with little legal protection.
ex.zh: 过去，富裕家庭的佣人往往长时间工作，却很少受到法律保护。

tip: 公务员用civil servant，不能只说servant。
教材补充词；首次出现于高一下，来源：必修第三册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: Having little depth from the surface to the bottom
Lacking serious thought, understanding, or emotional depth
Taking only a small amount of air into the lungs

ex.en: The children splashed happily in the shallow end of the pool.
ex.zh: 孩子们在泳池浅水区开心地戏水。

ex.en: Shallow coastal waters provide important habitats for young fish, making their protection essential for sustainable fisheries.
ex.zh: 浅海沿岸水域为幼鱼提供重要栖息地，因此保护这些水域对渔业的可持续发展至关重要。

tip: 水浅或思想肤浅都可用shallow，反义词为deep。

senses.en: A fish with a cartilage skeleton and usually sharp teeth.
Someone who cheats others, especially to get their money.

ex.en: We watched a shark swim slowly behind the aquarium glass.
ex.zh: 我们看着一条鲨鱼在水族馆的玻璃后缓缓游动。

ex.en: Protecting shark populations helps maintain balanced marine ecosystems because many species regulate the numbers of other animals.
ex.zh: 保护鲨鱼种群有助于维持海洋生态平衡，因为许多鲨鱼物种能调节其他动物的数量。

tip: loan shark指放高利贷者，不是某种鲨鱼。

senses.en: Having an edge or point that cuts or pierces easily.
Sudden and large in degree or amount.
Quick to notice, understand, or respond to things.

ex.en: This knife is sharp enough to slice tomatoes easily.
ex.zh: 这把刀足够锋利，切番茄很轻松。

ex.en: A sharp increase in housing costs has forced many young adults to delay moving out of their parents' homes.
ex.zh: 住房成本急剧上涨，迫使许多年轻人推迟搬离父母家的计划。

tip: 形容变化时常指幅度大且突然，如a sharp rise。

senses.en: A large piece of cloth used to cover a bed.
A thin, flat piece of paper, metal, or another material.

ex.en: I spread a clean sheet over the mattress.
ex.zh: 我在床垫上铺了一条干净的床单。

ex.en: Schools can reduce paper waste by encouraging students to use both sides of each sheet.
ex.zh: 学校可以鼓励学生使用每张纸的正反两面，以减少纸张浪费。

col: a sheet of glass｜一块玻璃
tip: sheet是可数名词；一张纸说a sheet of paper。

senses.en: A sound, movement, or light that communicates a message.
An electrical or radio wave carrying information.
Communicate through an action, or indicate that something is happening.

ex.en: The coach gave a signal, and we started running.
ex.zh: 教练发出信号后，我们开始跑步。

ex.en: Increasing investment in renewable energy may signal a government's commitment to reducing its dependence on fossil fuels.
ex.zh: 增加可再生能源投资，可能表明政府致力于减少对化石燃料的依赖。

tip: 过去式英式常写signalled，美式常写signaled。

senses.en: large or important enough to deserve attention
expressing a meaning that is not directly stated

ex.en: Moving closer to work made a significant difference to me.
ex.zh: 搬到工作地点附近对我的生活产生了很大的影响。

ex.en: Access to reliable internet services has a significant impact on educational opportunities in remote communities.
ex.zh: 能否获得可靠的互联网服务，对偏远社区的教育机会有重大影响。

col: a significant glance｜意味深长的一瞥
tip: 统计上significant指达到显著性标准，不等于实际影响很大。
教材补充词；首次出现于高一下，来源：必修第二册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: The natural outer covering of a person's or animal's body.
The thin outer layer of certain fruits and vegetables.
Remove the skin from an animal, fruit or vegetable.

ex.en: My skin feels dry after swimming in the pool.
ex.zh: 在泳池游泳后，我觉得皮肤很干。

ex.en: Protecting skin from excessive sunlight can reduce the risk of serious health problems later in life.
ex.zh: 保护皮肤免受过度日晒，可以降低日后出现严重健康问题的风险。

tip: 指人体皮肤通常不可数；一张兽皮可数。

senses.en: A mobile phone with internet access and computer-like functions.

ex.en: I used my smartphone to photograph the evening sky.
ex.zh: 我用智能手机拍下了傍晚的天空。

ex.en: Although smartphones provide convenient access to information, excessive use may disrupt sleep and reduce concentration.
ex.zh: 虽然智能手机让获取信息更加方便，但过度使用可能干扰睡眠并降低专注力。

tip: smartphone是可数名词，通常写成一个词。

senses.en: A substance used with water to clean skin or objects.
A continuing television or radio drama about everyday relationships.
To rub or wash something with soap.

ex.en: Please wash your hands with soap before lunch.
ex.zh: 午饭前请用肥皂洗手。

ex.en: Providing clean water and soap in schools can help prevent infections and improve children's overall health.
ex.zh: 在学校提供清洁用水和肥皂有助于预防感染，改善儿童的整体健康状况。

col: a bar of soap｜一块肥皂
tip: 指清洁用品通常不可数；一块用a bar of soap。

senses.en: programs that tell a computer how to perform tasks

ex.en: This software helps me edit photos on my laptop.
ex.zh: 这个软件帮助我在笔记本电脑上编辑照片。

ex.en: Schools need reliable software and adequate teacher training to make effective use of digital learning tools.
ex.zh: 学校需要可靠的软件和充分的教师培训，才能有效利用数字学习工具。

tip: 不可数：说some software，不说a software。

senses.zh: 以某种方式（或方法）；不知怎么地

tip: 教材补充词；首次出现于高一下，来源：必修第二册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: An object kept to remember a place, person, or event.

ex.en: We bought a small wooden boat as a souvenir.
ex.zh: 我们买了一只小木船作为纪念品。

ex.en: Buying a locally made souvenir can support traditional crafts and provide income for communities that depend on tourism.
ex.zh: 购买当地制作的纪念品可以支持传统工艺，并为依靠旅游业的社区带来收入。

tip: 常用a souvenir of表示某次旅行或活动的纪念品。

senses.zh: 太空行走；太空行走的时间

tip: 教材补充词；首次出现于高一下，来源：必修第三册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: A biological group whose members can usually breed with one another.

ex.en: Several species of butterfly visit our garden each summer.
ex.zh: 每年夏天都有几种蝴蝶来到我们的花园。

ex.en: Protecting natural habitats is essential for preventing the extinction of species threatened by human activity.
ex.zh: 保护自然栖息地对于防止受人类活动威胁的物种灭绝至关重要。

tip: 单复数同形：one species，many species。

senses.en: containing spices, often with a strong, hot flavour

ex.en: The noodles were too spicy, so I ordered rice.
ex.zh: 面条太辣了，所以我点了米饭。

ex.en: Traditional spicy dishes can attract visitors who want to experience the distinctive flavours of a region.
ex.zh: 传统的辛辣菜肴能吸引想要体验当地独特风味的游客。

tip: spicy指香料味浓或辣；hot也可指温度高。
